visual_logic.color_palette: Dark slate-blue with a creamy-yellow underbelly and a subtle 'frill' of dark clay scales along the spine, running continuously along its horizontal profile.
visual_logic.pattern_strategy: Sun-dappled camouflage; pale sand-colored body with dark 'fractal' spots mapped cleanly across its horizontal lateral flank.
visual_logic.facial_silhouette: Small, lizard-like head with large, alert eyes; transitional semi-aquatic features oriented perfectly to face laterally in the frame.
visual_logic.texture: Small, overlapping diamond-shaped clay scales; glossy black eyes, rendered parallel to the camera plane.
visual_logic.environment: Vibrant blue water. The massive white 'clay' splashes are shifted entirely into the distant background layers to preserve a sharp, measurable silhouette line.

pose: The primitive semi-aquatic mosasauroid is oriented entirely in a strict lateral profile view, swimming horizontally from left to right parallel to the frame boundaries. The original stationary rock-basking pose is unrolled and stabilized into a flat, level, straight cruising path. This stretches its lizard-like head, slender body with wet-look impasto highlights, limbs, and tail end-to-end to cleanly track alongside the central UI measuring tape system.
